title: Accept the reproducible M2 technical result as sufficient baseline for M3 without retroactive executor authorization
approval_source: Resuelvo PEND-LAB-034 aceptando el resultado técnico reproducible de M2 como baseline suficiente para M3, sin otorgar autorización retroactiva a la ejecución de la autorización 155. Autorizo únicamente preparar la decisión y la autorización acotada de entrada a M3; todavía no autorizo ejecutar M3.
subject: PEND-LAB-034
rationale: The M2 technical result is deterministic and reproducible.
The active selector and all authority, runtime and integration boundaries remain unchanged.
A new Codex rerun would not retroactively correct the historical executor variance.
The evidentiary value of repeating the same deterministic M2 materialization is not proportional to the cost.
The historical executor variance remains visible and is not converted into prior authorization.
consequences: PEND-LAB-034 is canonically closed with the accepted-baseline resolution.
The M2 result may be used as the frozen technical baseline for a separately authorized M3 dual evaluation.
Authorization 157 and its bounded execution brief are published as proposals for human review.
M3 remains blocked until authorization 157 is explicitly granted.
Any M3 result must preserve the historical M2 executor variance without retroactive authority.
